She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 371 Country: FR Title: In madhhab hanefi is it not allowed to pray with shooes even if they are clean? I follow hanafi madhhab but for confort of my heart I prefer proven fatwa? Question: In madhhab hanefi is it not allowed to pray with shooes even if they are clean? I follow hanafi madhhab but for confort of my heart I prefer proven fatwa? Answer ID: 371 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 467/J) If anyone prays in new shoes sometimes then it will be allowed, but it is not good to pray salah wearing old shoes, it should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
